title: Benefits of being a Legacy Business

paragraphs: Long-standing small businesses can receive recognition, business help, and grants.

sections.heading: Recognition
paragraphs: Legacy Businesses are added to the Legacy Business map.
Several neighborhoods are featured in self-guided walking tours: Legacy Walks .
Legacy Businesses receive branded certificates, window clings, stickers, and lapel pins, and other swag, when available.
Heritage Happy Hour , a program San Francisco Heritage, typically occurs on the second Thursday of every month from 5:00 to 7:00 p.m. at a different Legacy Business.
More information: Promote being on the Legacy Business Registry .

sections.heading: Business assistance
paragraphs: Legacy Businesses receive the quarterly newsletter Legacy Business Light and the monthly Office of Small Business newsletter.

Legacy Businesses can contact the Legacy Business Program for questions or assistance regarding finances, leasing, permitting, succession planning, or other business challenges. We’ll guide you to the right people who can help you.

sections.heading: Grants
paragraphs: The Business Stabilization Grant is an incentive for landlords to provide long-term leases to Legacy Businesses.

sections.heading: Legislation
paragraphs: See legislation that supports Legacy Businesses .
